Dr. Domenicali is a competent and empathetic doctor, but what makes him special is his unconditional love for animals. He is wonderfully human, able to reassure, inform, and honestly share everything he can to help animals.
Yesterday afternoon, we freed our beloved Ayron from suffering, and he demonstrated a sensitivity and kindness of soul never seen before in a veterinarian... I recommend anyone who loves their pet to trust him and his staff completely. Thank you again for everything.

I was looking for a place to take my one-month-old kitten for his first visit and a checkup for a cold. Given the good reviews, I decided to try this clinic, and I have to say, I was very satisfied. During the first visit, the kitten was checked out and all my questions were answered. They also performed a fecal test for deworming in 1 hour and called me back immediately with the results, as well as providing a prescription for the cold. I returned a few days later to administer the medication to the kitten. They seemed very helpful and knowledgeable, the wait for appointments was short, and the prices were truly reasonable: the first visit was free.
A heartfelt thank you to everyone, but especially to Dr. Brusoni for his professionalism and great patience. THANK YOU!

I want to thank Dr. Domenicali, Dr. Brusoni, and the entire staff for the care and professionalism they've shown my dog ​​Nami over the years. A special thank you for the support they've shown us throughout her life.

Thank you so much for your care and attention during this very delicate journey.

Liliana Rizzati

I went to the clinic after a walk with my French bulldog puppy because her nose had become swollen. Dr. Cristina greeted me, and after a brief examination, she gave her a cortisone shot, and within 10 minutes, my furry friend started feeling better.
The doctor was truly kind and gentle in administering the shot.
After the bad experiences I had with my old vet, I will definitely continue taking my pets to them.
Thank you for your kindness <3

On Friday, I went to the clinic for the billionth time in the 24 years I've been in Baggio, and every time my dogs are treated with the utmost professionalism and care. However, I'd like to highlight the human side, which is never a given: all the staff are very welcoming, patient, and above all reassuring. Even my little Akita, Reimi, had a wonderful time. THANK YOU SO MUCH, Team Domenicali!!!!
The veterinarians are very well trained.

Today we visited Dr. Domenicali's office for what was supposed to be a checkup, but it turned out to be an emergency surgery for our furry little girl. His entire team welcomed and supported us with all the love they have for their profession and for our animals. A heartfelt thank you is only right.

Excellent impression! The staff were kind, helpful, and knowledgeable, but above all, they were loving with the animals. The atmosphere was pleasant and very clean.

We couldn't have had a better veterinarian in Baggio. He's highly experienced, friendly, and skilled. He's always up-to-date and knowledgeable about new animal technologies. He also relies on external veterinarians for delicate procedures. Overall, an excellent staff and great expertise.
Courtesy, attention to detail, kindness, humanity, and professionalism, with an eye on the reasonable fee, which never hurts. Highly recommended! Thanks to them, my Connor is now doing great!

Renovated a few years ago, the practice is well-maintained, clean, and equipped with all the necessary equipment for caring for our four-legged friends.
On-time visits are provided, and the team is well-trained. They work with passion, expertise, and love, without underestimating the owner's emotional connection! I've been going to them for at least 20 years. For me, they're the best, both for basic vaccinations and more complex surgeries!
